name: Cloud Browser Workspace
postStartCommand: mkdir -p /workspaces/test-client/.chromium-data && (docker start chromium 2>/dev/null || (docker run -d --name=chromium -e PUID=1000 -e PGID=1000 -e TZ=Etc/UTC -e CHROME_CLI='https://discord.com/app https://www.instagram.com https://www.tiktok.com' -p 3000:3000 -p 3001:3001 -v chromium_data:/config --security-opt seccomp=unconfined --shm-size='2gb' --restart unless-stopped lscr.io/linuxserver/chromium:latest && sleep 3 && docker cp /workspaces/test-client/.chromium-data/. chromium:/config/ 2>/dev/null))
